0022600210.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-5, 11th in the West) visit the Golden State Warriors (7-3, 5th in the West), who enter on a seven-game winning streak while New Orleans has lost its last game and is 1-2 on the road. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 113-109 Pelicans win in New Orleans on February 24, though New Orleans lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2. Yves Missi is out for the Pelicans with a knee bruise, while the Warriors are without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision.
